programme.title: Parishram (the Effort)
programme.desc: The reality check hits hard when the OSC results are announced and Ravi fails his first attempt. He faces taunts from his family and the crushing weight of societal judgment. Encouraged by Jyoti, who provides both emotional support and a strategic plan, Ravi moves from being a "casual" student to a "hardcore" aspirant. This episode highlights the physical and mental "grind" involved in the preparation.

programme.title: Avroh (the Descent)
programme.desc: As the wait for the next exam cycle continues, the "high" of hard work starts to fade into a "low" (Avroh means descent). Financial struggles, family tensions, and unexpected "villains" in the form of societal gatekeepers threaten to derail him. Ravi is forced to make difficult choices between his relationship with Jyoti and his focus on the exam, as the cracks in his mental health begin to show.

programme.title: Prateeksha (the Finale The Wait)
programme.desc: The finale focuses on the most agonizing part of the process: the wait. Ravi faces his final hurdles and a major internal crisis of self-doubt. The episode serves as a powerful commentary on the Indian examination system, exploring whether a job title truly defines a person's worth. It concludes Raviranjan's journey by showing how he manages to reclaim his self-respect (Swabhiman), regardless of the exam result.

programme.title: Humse Na Ho Paayega
programme.desc: The episode sets the stage for the ultimate "Generation Gap" social experiment. Akash (Rohan Shah) and Pooja (Aditi Myakal) are a modern married couple living in a spacious Mumbai apartment. However, their lifestyle is outpacing their income, leading them to a radical decision: renting out their spare rooms to bachelors.

programme.title: Khan-Daan
programme.desc: After the initial adjustment period of the pilot, the household faces its first major logistical crisis—Food. The episode explores the chaos of shared groceries, differing diets, and the "disaster" that is a communal refrigerator.

programme.title: Safai-Squad
programme.desc: After weeks of living together, the apartment has reached a state of "critical mess." Aashna (Kriti Vij), who takes pride in a clean and aesthetic home, finally snaps. The episode follows the couple's attempt to militarize the house cleaning process and the bachelors' hilariously lazy resistance.

programme.title: Family Ban Gayi
programme.desc: The episode begins with a sense of impending change. After weeks of chaos, the experimental living arrangement—where a married couple (Akash and Pooja) shares their home with three bachelors (Rohit, Mohit, and Vishi)—is put to the test.

programme.title: Hotel California
programme.desc: Maya, a Gen Z UX designer, joins Thoda Sukoon — a mental health startup with strict office hours, long workdays, and zero breathing space. Expecting flexibility and support, she instead finds herself caught in a whirlwind of deadlines and old-school hustle. As pressure mounts ahead of a major product launch and funding round, Maya connects with her burnt-out teammates. But when it comes to challenging the system — who’s willing to speak up?

programme.title: The Launch
programme.desc: Tight deadlines. Zero chill. And one very fed-up Maya. Maya’s ideas get ghosted, her dedication’s under the scanner, and the team? Busy minding their own burnout. Just when she finds a bit of empathy, things spiral again. Sleep is a myth, pressure is real, and Maya’s had enough. But when push comes to shove… does she stay, or finally hit CTRL+ALT+ESC?

programme.title: All Is Well
programme.desc: Maya’s impulsive decision leaves her awkward around Chirag, who doesn’t miss a chance to tease her. As they open up about their generational views on work and life, Maya reaffirms her belief in mental health and Thoda Sukoon’s mission. But just as things start looking up, a bold move in a high-stakes meeting sparks serious tension with the higher-ups. Can Maya recover when her values put her at odds with the very system she’s trying to change?

programme.title: The Breakdown
programme.desc: While the team scrambles to fix minor app bugs, the real issues at Thoda Sukoon are swept under the rug — until it all explodes. An employee collapses from overwork, triggering a full-blown social media backlash. As tensions rise, Maya and Chirag are forced to face unresolved conflict, and the team must ask: how far is too far? Can this crisis spark real change in a toxic work culture, or is it already too late?

programme.title: The Cliffhanger
programme.desc: In the aftermath of Riddhi's collapse, Zooni spearheads a desperate negotiation for better working conditions. As a seemingly balanced work environment emerges, the team struggles to deliver, and blurred lines between professional and personal lives begin to fray. Are these simply growing pains for Thoda Sukoon, or are fresh, explosive complications on the horizon?

programme.title: The Misfit
programme.desc: India’s fashion matriarch, Zahira, is making a bold move - bringing Zahiraan into the world of wearable luxury. But there’s a catch - neither she nor her team knows how to navigate this shift. Thus, comes in Ayesha - a rookie designer, a dreamer bursting with fresh ideas. But will she survive the cut-throat competition in fashion and at Zahiraan? Get ready for an intense drama, glamorous showdowns, and career-defining moments as the battle for success begins at Zahiraan.

programme.title: Time To Shine
programme.desc: Ayesha’s out-of-the-box ideas leave a mark on Zahira, but not everyone is impressed. As she tries to navigate the high-pressure world of fashion, her bold creativity ignites a war with her team. Amidst the chaos, an unexpected friendship with Sanchi gives Ayesha the confidence boost she desperately needs. But in an industry where talent isn’t enough, will this newfound support be her key to a major breakthrough?

programme.title: The Big Launch
programme.desc: The much-awaited Zahiraan launch is here, but disaster strikes! One unexpected error threatens to crumble Ayesha's hard-won validation from Zahira, and jeopardize both their careers. Meanwhile, Karan battles crippling self-doubt, wondering if he'll ever measure up to the perfection demanded by the high-stakes fashion world. Will their reputations survive?

programme.title: Perfect Shaadi
programme.desc: Aditya and Prajakta are all set to tie the knot! As they navigate the excitement and chaos of wedding planning, a surprise guest from Prajakta's past arrives, turning their perfect day upside down. Will love triumph over unexpected challenges?

programme.title: Basundi Ki Bhasudi
programme.desc: As Aditya and Prajakta celebrate their pre-wedding festivities, a shocking twist turns their world upside down! Will they handle the chaos together?

programme.title: Hum Tum Aur?
programme.desc: A perfect wedding, a hidden secret, and a love under threat. Will Aditya and Prajakta's love story survive the test of time?

programme.title: Bride Ka Best Man
programme.desc: As pre-wedding festivities unfold, Aditya stumbles upon a secret only Prajakta’s best friend knew. Can he handle the parts of her he’s just beginning to see?

programme.title: Imperfect Shaadi
programme.desc: The episode centers on the wedding of the lead couple, where everything seemingly goes wrong. However, instead of letting the chaos ruin the day, the couple realizes that the "imperfections" of their wedding reflect the reality of their relationship. They choose to embrace the mess, focusing on their commitment to each other.

programme.title: Infection
programme.desc: The series introduces Nishant, Sakshi, and Huma as they begin their MBBS journey, adjusting to the demanding environment of medical college and forming new friendships.

programme.title: Diagnosis
programme.desc: A month into their studies, the trio struggles to balance an overwhelming syllabus, challenging practicals, and the desire to enjoy college life. An unexpected revelation about Nishant changes the group's dynamics.

programme.title: Complications
programme.desc: Midterm results bring surprises, prompting celebrations that uncover deeper issues the friends must confront together.

programme.title: Surgery
programme.desc: Huma faces a crisis of confidence, seeking unconventional advice to regain her footing. A heartbreaking event forces the friends to reevaluate their priorities and the strength of their bond.

programme.title: Recovery
programme.desc: As final exams approach, Huma contemplates unethical shortcuts, leading to revelations that challenge perceptions and test the integrity of their friendship.

programme.title: Honeymoon Period
programme.desc: The series introduces Nishant, Sakshi, and Huma as they begin their MBBS journey, adjusting to the demanding environment of medical college and forming new friendships.

programme.title: Donning
programme.desc: A month into their studies, the trio struggles to balance an overwhelming syllabus, challenging practicals, and the desire to enjoy college life. An unexpected revelation about Nishant changes the group's dynamics.

programme.title: Patient Zero
programme.desc: Midterm results bring surprises, prompting celebrations that uncover deeper issues the friends must confront together.

programme.title: Lockdown
programme.desc: Huma faces a crisis of confidence, seeking unconventional advice to regain her footing. A heartbreaking event forces the friends to reevaluate their priorities and the strength of their bond.

programme.title: Critical Condition
programme.desc: As final exams approach, Huma contemplates unethical shortcuts, leading to revelations that challenge perceptions and test the integrity of their friendship.

programme.title: Fomo
programme.desc: Dhruv and Kavya plan a lazy Sunday but feel the pressure of missing out when they see their friends enjoying exciting activities on social media. This leads them to seek ways to spice up their day.

programme.title: Have A Nice Day
programme.desc: A morning rush to work results in a tussle between Dhruv and Kavya, spoiling their moods. Throughout the day, they attempt to make amends, highlighting the irony and sweetness of their relationship.

programme.title: Good Night
programme.desc: A sleepless night due to mosquitoes leads to the discovery that Kavya's ex-boyfriend is getting married, prompting a long conversation about their past relationships.

programme.title: Thank You!
programme.desc: Plans for a dinner at an Iranian restaurant get canceled, leading Dhruv and Kavya to attend a friend's house party. The night evolves into an unexpected adventure, ending at a local fair.

programme.title: Here We Go!
programme.desc: During a visit to a vineyard, Dhruv and Kavya open up about their insecurities and future aspirations, leading to deeper conversations about life and their relationship.

programme.title: Masterji
programme.desc: Kishore, an orphan has only one dream, to join the IndianArmy. When he gets thrown out of his orphanage, Masterji, an ex-army officer who left the army and is now working as a tailor, reluctantly adopts him. The khadoos Masterji and Kishore have only two things in common, their dream to serve the nation and their lonely lives. Will Masterji help Kishore achieve his own unfulfilled dreams to become a soldier, and will Kishore find a father in Masterji?

programme.title: Jaldi Lautna, Captain
programme.desc: Captain Vikrant Sahay and his wife Vibha had a beautiful love story. But Vikrant’s sudden death in battle leaves the otherwise happy-go-lucky Vibha completely shocked. Unable to deal with Vikrant’s death, Vibha decides that the best way to honor him is to fulfill his dream, by joining the army herself, much against her family’s wishes. Will Vibha succeed and make her late husband, her family, and the country proud?

programme.title: Shooter Jawan
programme.desc: Tribhuvan, a dedicated Indian Army Officer comes across a young sweeper Tinku, who is a gifted shooter. Tribhuvan knows Tinku has a rare talent, and wants to enroll him in the shooting academy and then the Indian Army. However, owing to Tinku’s caste, his father is afraid of society’s taunts and is completely against this career choice. Will Tinku have the courage to fight back and rise above ‘log kya kahenge’?

programme.title: Sarhad Ke Baad Bhi
programme.desc: Colonel Balram, a retired Indian Army Officer, returns home after several years of service, only to find himself completely disconnected from his son Aman. While Balram is failing at mending his relationship with Aman, he is also silently struggling with mental health issues, because of his days at war. Will Aman ever understand his father’s sacrifices for the country or will it be too late before he realises just how much his father loves him?

programme.title: Veera
programme.desc: Veera’s martyred father’s last wish was for her to join the Indian armed forces. But Veera is not for it. The bravery and patriotism that the country remembers and celebrates him for, are the same things that took Veera’s father away from her. She’s been carrying this anger and hurt in her heart for too long, until she discovers a hidden letter.

programme.title: Bachelorhood
programme.desc: Viraj and Arjun have been best friends since childhood. While Viraj loves his bachelor life and wants Arjun to move in as his flatmate, Arjun has other plans of ‘settling down’. What happens when this bachelor reveals he wants to be ‘unbachelored?’

programme.title: Kabab Mein Haddi
programme.desc: The gang gets together to celebrate Arjun’s big news, but Viraj is concerned whether the dynamics of the group will change with its new addition. Will Khushi win over the gang and get Viraj's stamp of approval?

programme.title: (un)happy Birthday
programme.desc: Its Arjun’s birthday, and Khushi steals the limelight with her unconventional celebration party. Tensions at the party rise when Viraj confronts Arjun about his change in behaviour since he started dating Khushi. Will Arjun pick pyaar or dosti?

programme.title: Mann Ki Rant
programme.desc: The group tries to resolve tensions between Viraj and Arjun, but they both resist. As Viraj rants to Zara and Kaka about his friendships and relationships, he realises more about his true self.

programme.title: Yaar Ki Shaadi
programme.desc: The wedding day is here! Will Viraj stand by Arjun on the most important day of his life, and will he admit his true feelings to a special someone?

programme.title: Conflict Of Interest
programme.desc: Shagun wants to keep the Filmy Weddings business floating and for that she’s willing to go to any lengths. Even if it means shooting a wedding film for Adhira’s ex-boyfriend – Akhil. Adhira is furious and tries her best to sabotage the entire project. Unfortunately, her one big hurdle is Dad, who has taken quite a fondness for Akhil. Check out the episode and find out what happens next!

programme.title: Internal Politics
programme.desc: Adhira and Shagun are in a disagreement about whom to select for a wedding film promo: a boring aunt from the bride's side or a lively drunk aunt from the groom's family. Things take a turn for the complicated when the parents also weigh in with their respective biases.

programme.title: Poaching The Talent
programme.desc: Vishnu, the Agarwal's househelp cum man friday is desired by the sisters as an office boy to help them sort out their business affairs. The parents are naturally opposed to the idea. Thus begins another standoff in the Agarwal household - and Vishnu's position in the house is at stake. Who will finally lay claim over Vishnu's priceless services?

programme.title: Business Secrets
programme.desc: In a footage from a wedding they just filmed, the sisters find a drunken confession from the bride's best friend. It turns out she is the groom's ex - and he hasn't told the bride to be. Caught in the moral dilemma of choosing to tell the bride or not, the sisters find themselves on other ends of the argument. Meanwhile, it is revealed that Adhira's father might have a similar secret hidden from everyone. Will the sisters do the morally right thing or the financially right thing? And what is the father's bizarre obsession with knowing who the groom's mom is?

programme.title: Breach Of Contract
programme.desc: Chasing a competitive business pitch to work for a coveted fashion firm, the sisters are again at different sides of a dilemma. The commitment to the new opportunity would be for a minimum two years, which Adhira is reluctant to make at the age of 25. Whereas Shagun, having already quit her high paying corporate job to join this business, sees no harm in seizing the opportunity with open arms. As their argument turns to a fight, we are left wondering if this is in fact the fight to end all fights. Will the sisters come to the same page and work for the pitch? Or will Happily Hitched disband for good?

programme.title: Arranged Family
programme.desc: Nikhil Solanki arrives at his in-laws' home, where a series of mishaps culminate in a significant blunder that upsets his father-in-law, Prakash Sharma. Both struggle to address the situation openly.

programme.title: The Mad House
programme.desc: Prakash avoids acknowledging that Nikhil damaged his car, instead blaming neighborhood children. Nikhil's attempts to rectify the situation lead to further complications.

programme.title: Conditions Apply
programme.desc: During Sudha and Prakash's anniversary celebration, relatives pose uncomfortable questions, challenging Nikhil's patience and composure.

programme.title: Stuck In The Middle
programme.desc: A disagreement between Anita and her parents results in a cold war, leaving Nikhil caught between his wife and in-laws.

programme.title: Home
programme.desc: Nikhil expresses his feelings of being an outsider within the family, prompting an open discussion aimed at resolving underlying issues.

programme.title: Welcome Home
programme.desc: A few months after moving to Mumbai, Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) and Anita are finally settled. The peace is interrupted by the arrival of Nikhil's parents, Kiran (Shishir Sharma) and Vandana (Renuka Shahane), for a short visit. Anita, ever the perfectionist, is anxious to be the "perfect daughter-in-law," but her efforts are met with a series of awkward and hilarious hurdles.

programme.title: Surprise, Surprise!
programme.desc: The episode picks up with the fallout of Nikhil’s father, Kiran (Shishir Sharma), going missing during his walk in the previous episode. While he eventually returns, the tension doesn't dissipate. The "surprise" of the title is twofold: the unexpected arrival of Nikhil’s sister, Shreya (Kriti Vij), and the unsettling realization that something is physically or mentally "off" with Kiran.

programme.title: Spilling The Beans
programme.desc: The entire family—Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh), Anita (Eisha Chopra), Kiran (Shishir Sharma), Vandana (Renuka Shahane), and Shreya (Kriti Vij)—piles into a car to attend a relative's 60th birthday celebration. What was meant to be a joyful getaway becomes a pressure cooker for the long-standing resentment between the siblings.

programme.title: Something's Missing
programme.desc: The title is a poignant double entendre: it refers to a missing set of rings at the family function, but more deeply, it refers to the "missing" pieces of Kiran’s (Shishir Sharma) memory. The facade of a "normal family vacation" finally crumbles, forcing the Solankis to stop pretending.

programme.title: House Of Cards
programme.desc: The title "House of Cards" refers to the fragile "perfect family" image the Solankis have tried to maintain. After the emotional explosion regarding Kiran’s (Shishir Sharma) health and Shreya’s (Kriti Vij) marriage, the "house" has finally collapsed—but in its place, something more honest is being built.

programme.title: Home
programme.desc: In the Season 2 finale, "Home," Anita and Nikhil prepare to move into their own place. The episode resolves the season's friction between Anita and her mother-in-law, replacing awkward formalities with genuine mutual respect. As they move out, the story concludes that "home" isn't about physical space, but the emotional bridge built between two different generations.

programme.title: Circle Of Life
programme.desc: The title "Circle of Life" refers to the poignant role reversal where the children now become the guardians of their parents, mirroring the care they once received.

programme.title: Not Kidding
programme.desc: The episode centers on a visit from Anita’s boisterous, unfiltered parents—Akshata (Deepika Amin) and Kiran Sharma (Shishir Sharma). The quiet, disciplined, and currently somber Solanki household is suddenly upended by the high-energy Sharmas. The primary conflict arises when the two sets of parents have a "polite clash" over how to care for the ailing Kiran Solanki and, more pivotally, the couple's future plans regarding children.

programme.title: Here We Go Again
programme.desc: With the house now fully "merged," Anita (Eisha Chopra) and Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) decide to throw a surprise anniversary party for the "Folks." While their intentions are pure, the episode explores how a "celebration" can quickly become a source of stress when dealing with a chronic illness and interfering relatives.

programme.title: Zor Se Bolo
programme.desc: The episode revolves around a chaotic Sunday at the Solanki household. The central plot involves Kiran Solanki (Shishir Sharma) needing a hearing aid, but it quickly spirals into a larger commentary on how the family members are "deaf" to each other's actual needs and desires.

programme.title: That's All Folks
programme.desc: The finale moves away from the day-to-day bickering and centers on a quiet realization: Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) and Anita (Eisha Chopra) have finally stopped "adjusting" and have started living. The episode focuses on the family accepting their "New Normal" while acknowledging that the road ahead with Kiran’s (Shishir Sharma) health will be challenging but shared.

programme.title: Truth Bombs
programme.desc: The episode begins with Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) and Anita (Esha Chopra) gathering the family for a "serious talk." After months of private deliberation, they drop the ultimate truth bomb: they have decided to adopt a child instead of pursuing a biological pregnancy.

programme.title: The Damaad Test
programme.desc: The episode centers on the Home Study, a critical step in the Indian adoption process where a government social worker visits the family to determine if they are fit to raise a child. However, the title "The Damaad Test" (The Son-in-law Test) refers to the parallel pressure Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) feels to prove he is a "good son" while also being a "good son-in-law" to Anita’s (Eisha Chopra) visiting parents.

programme.title: Ladkiwale Vs. Ladkewale
programme.desc: While Anita (Eisha Chopra) and Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) are stuck in the agonizing "waiting period" of the CARA process, the tension shifts to the two sets of parents. The episode highlights that even when everyone agrees on the goal (the grandchild), their different ways of expressing love and anxiety can lead to a hilarious yet deep-seated cultural clash.

programme.title: Are We Ready?
programme.desc: The wait is over: Anita and Nikhil are matched with a child. However, instead of the pure euphoria they expected, they are hit with a wave of intense anxiety. The title "Are We Ready?" reflects the internal crisis the couple faces as they realize their lives are about to change irrevocably—not in nine months, but in a matter of days.

programme.title: What The Future?
programme.desc: The finale begins with the arrival of the moment Anita (Eisha Chopra) and Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) have spent the entire season preparing for: bringing their adopted daughter home. The episode isn't just about the new arrival, but about how each family member adapts to their "What The Future" role.

programme.title: Comfort Zone
programme.desc: Shaurya struggles with getting recognition for his efforts at work while Sanya debates shifting out of her home. Both of them help each other step out of their comfort zones and grow

programme.title: Time Off
programme.desc: As Shaurya and Sanya shift in together, Sanya takes a gamble at work which impacts both of their lives.

programme.title: Emotion Or Logic
programme.desc: As Shaurya and Sanya deal with the realization of having fallen for each other, they have to prioritize what is more important - emotions or logic?

programme.title: New Roles
programme.desc: Having finally admitted their feelings to each other, Shaurya and Sanya's honeymoon weekend is over and they must get back to reality. With Shaurya up for a promotion and Sanya doubtful about her growth in this company, what is this new couple in for?

programme.title: Milestones
programme.desc: With appraisals around the corner, Shaurya and Sanya brace themselves for the unexpected. Eventually, Shaurya gets his first real lesson in team management and Sanya makes a crucial decision to help her get what she wants.

programme.desc: Your fitness-obsessed partner influences every meal, routine, and outing, sometimes to extremes. The video shows how your relationship adjusts — from diet talks to gym push pressures.

programme.title: When You Try To Quit Smoking
programme.desc: The internal battle, cravings, relapses, and justifications you go through attempting to quit. The video dramatizes how every trigger, slip, and “just one more” happens in your head.

programme.title: Reality Of Having Anxiety
programme.desc: This video realistically portrays the everyday struggles of living with anxiety. It highlights common experiences like overthinking conversations , feeling self-conscious in social situations, and the physical symptoms of anxiety such as sweating palms, shortness of breath, and fatigue.

programme.title: Struggles Of Exam Prep
programme.desc: The all-too-real chaos of exam season: the sleepless nights, panic Google searches, last-minute revision, family pressure and the weird peace when the exam sheet finally drops.

programme.title: When You Are A Dog Parent
programme.desc: The joys and weirdness of treating your dog like your child: the endless photos, checking if they’re okay when you’re away, the guilt, the silly little routines, the unconditional love wrapped in fur.

programme.title: Wedding Romance: Falling In Love At Your Bff's Wedding | Part 2 Ft.
programme.desc: At your best friend's wedding you unexpectedly fall for someone: the stolen glances during the ceremony, the shared laughter in a corner, and the dilemma of a new beginning in an old friendship setting.

programme.title: Every Introvert Ever
programme.desc: This video comically depicts the relatable struggles and unique behaviors of introverts. It showcases situations like avoiding social gatherings, pretending to be busy to escape conversations, and finding joy in solitude, all while highlighting the inner world of an introvert

programme.title: Things We Did In College
programme.desc: The free-spirited college days: late-night chats, spontaneous plans, weird life lectures from friends, figure-out-your-future stress, tons of memories that become “remember when” moments later.

programme.title: When Your Sibling Knows Your Secret
programme.desc: That moment when your sibling drops a bomb–they know that thing you thought was buried forever—and the mix of panic, betrayal and relief that follows.

programme.title: The Boyfriend We All Deserve
programme.desc: A girl daydreams about the perfect boyfriend who gets her jokes, supports her quirks and is weirdly in sync with her mood swings. Reality then hits when she realises the gap between “ideal-boyfriend” and the human beside her.

programme.title: When You And Your Bff Are Complete Opposites
programme.desc: The one who’s impulsive and the one who plans; one loves the party and the other loves the book; yet you find a weird balance and strength in the fact that you’re totally different.

programme.title: If Office Were Like A Jungle
programme.desc: The wild ecosystem of office life, complete with predators (bosses), scavengers (gossipers), and survivors (you).

programme.title: Almost Shaadi At 4am
programme.desc: A hilarious “shaadi scene” unfolds in the dead of night when chaos, confusion, and last-minute wedding madness collide — because in every Indian wedding, something always goes wrong.

programme.title: Introvert Or Extrovert: Which One Are You?
programme.desc: The video humorously explores the quirks of both introverts and extroverts. It highlights their contrasting personalities and how they navigate everyday life.

programme.title: First Time And Girls
programme.desc: The excitement, nerves, awkwardness and bonding between girlfriends as they talk about/wonder about doing something for the “first time”—whatever “first time” means for them in that moment.

programme.title: Every College Romance
programme.desc: The coffee chats, late-night study groups that turn into deep talks, “let’s hang out” that become more than just notes swapping—and the inevitable chaos when love and exams clash.

programme.title: Thoughts You Have During A Haircut
programme.desc: As you sit in the salon chair you’re thinking: “Just a trim… keep it more than last time… hope they don’t mess it up…” — and your mind wanders. The video captures that internal monologue everyone has during a haircu

programme.title: A Day Without Electricity
programme.desc: How modern life collapses when the power’s out—no Wi-Fi, no AC, no Netflix—just panic, sweat, and forced bonding.

programme.title: If Google Were An Indian Aunty
programme.desc: The video humorously imagines Google behaving like a nosy Indian aunty. It highlights funny situations of over-involvement, unsolicited advice, and curious questions.

programme.title: Can Genz And Millennials Be Friends?
programme.desc: This video explores whether Gen Z and Millennials can truly be friends, highlighting their distinct traits and humorous cultural clashes. It showcases their differing approaches to work, relationships, and daily life, ultimately demonstrating how they navigate their friendship despite generational gaps.

programme.title: Awkward Moments With Your Crush
programme.desc: A compilation of hilariously cringe-worthy moments when your crush is around: the flustered smiles, mis-sent messages, the sudden silence when they walk in. All the awkwardness you try so hard to hide, front and centre.

programme.title: Lockdown Wala Birthday
programme.desc: The video humorously portrays what it’s like to celebrate a birthday during lockdown. It highlights missed traditions, creative adjustments, and the joy of simple celebrations.

programme.title: Every Long Distance Relationship
programme.desc: The late-night calls, bad network, missed birthdays, emotional reunions, and the constant tug between love and distance.

programme.title: Unlucky Moments That Ruin Your Day
programme.desc: The tiny tragedies—spilling coffee, missing the bus, dropping your phone—that somehow set off an entire day of bad luck.

programme.title: Every Office Bff
programme.desc: The video humorously showcases the special bond between office best friends. It highlights their gossip, support, and fun moments that make work bearable.

programme.title: What Moms Want Vs What They Get
programme.desc: A mom dreams of rest, praise, time with her kids — but she gets missed calls, last-minute pick-ups and zero sleep. The video uses humour and heart to contrast her wish-list versus real-life.

programme.title: Reality Of A Topper
programme.desc: Being a topper may seem like the ultimate dream—achieving the highest grades, getting all the accolades, and being the ""golden child."" But what’s the reality behind the perfect grades? The pressure, the expectations, and yes, the constant battle to stay at the top. In this hilarious sketch, we take a closer look at the life of a topper and what it's really like behind the shining medals.

programme.title: If Ekta Kapoor Directed Your Life
programme.desc: The video imagines daily life as if it were directed by Ekta Kapoor. It highlights dramatic reactions, over-the-top scenarios, and hilarious soap opera twists.

programme.title: The Razor Effect
programme.desc: One small action — like shaving / grooming — triggers a cascade of changes in attitude, confidence and how others treat you. The video shows how a little upgrade (razor, haircut) leads to big perceptions.

programme.title: Struggles Of House Cleaning
programme.desc: This video comically illustrates the various difficulties and challenges faced while attempting to clean a house. It highlights the often-relatable struggles of maintaining a clean living space

programme.title: Things Sisters Do
programme.desc: A sister-sister relationship: prank calls, borrowing clothes, fighting over the mirror, then insisting “I got you, always.” The video highlights the unique mix of rivalry and love sisters share.

programme.title: When Your Bff Is Leaving School
programme.desc: The bittersweet countdown: the late chats, the “let’s do something memorable” mood, packing up memories, and the quiet fear of “will things be the same after you go?”

programme.title: If Your Wife Could Hear Your Thoughts
programme.desc: A husband’s internal monologue meets the reality of his wife apparently reading his mind—every unspoken thought becomes a comedic disaster waiting to happen.

programme.title: School Best Friends During Lockdown
programme.desc: Online classes, missed canteen gossip, and the nostalgia of school friendships during isolation.

programme.title: When Girls Fall For Red Flags
programme.desc: A witty portrayal of how girls knowingly ignore every warning sign in relationships, convincing themselves that red flags are just “misunderstood.”

programme.title: When He Doesn’t Like You Back
programme.desc: You think maybe he does, you hope he might, you plan how you’ll act—but deep down you always know: the answer might be “no”; the video shows the sting of un-reciprocated feelings and how you deal.

programme.title: When Your Sibling Comes Home After A Long Time
programme.desc: The excitement, the over-preparing, the sibling rivalry resurfacing, and the joy of rediscovering the quirks you’d missed while they were away.

programme.title: Break-Up Ke Stages
programme.desc: This video humorously explores the various emotional stages people go through after a breakup, depicting the struggles and eventual healing process. It shows the journey of moving on and attempting to cut contact, highlighting the complexities of post-breakup emotions.

programme.title: Love-Hate Relationship With Older Siblings
programme.desc: You fight, you compete, you annoy each other, you envy each other—but you also protect each other, share jokes, and there’s a lifelong bond underneath the push-and-pull.

programme.title: Silly Things We've All Heard In Our Childhood
programme.desc: Those repetitive warnings, superstitions, myths, and sayings older generations say (“don’t sit like that or you’ll get bald,” etc.). A nostalgic, funny look at how kids heard and internalized them.

programme.title: Struggles Of An Indian Bride
programme.desc: The emotional, logistical, and social pressures a bride faces — from family expectations to dress fittings, guest dramas, and internal doubts. The video underscores how “big day” dreams collide with reality.

programme.title: If Acp Pradyuman (cid) Were Your Boss
programme.desc: The video imagines ACP Pradyuman as a boss in an office setting. It highlights the dramatic style, quirky dialogues, and funny outcomes of his leadership.

programme.title: Neighbourhood Romance: Meeting Your Crush After A Long Time
programme.desc: The story follows two former childhood neighbors who cross paths after a long period of separation. As they reconnect, the video explores the awkward yet charming evolution of their relationship—moving from "childhood crushes" to young adults navigating modern life.

programme.title: Stuff Brothers And Sisters Do
programme.desc: The video is a montage of everyday moments that define the "Tom and Jerry" relationship most siblings share. It captures the transition from intense fighting over trivial things to being each other's biggest support system.

programme.title: Falling For Your Best Friend
programme.desc: The story explores the delicate and often painful realization that you've developed romantic feelings for the one person you can’t afford to lose—your best friend. It follows the emotional journey of two inseparable friends as they navigate the blurry line between platonic comfort and romantic attraction.

programme.title: Signs You Are Becoming Like Your Partner
programme.desc: The video follows a couple as they realize they are slowly losing their individual quirks and merging into a single unit. It captures those "Oh no, I’ve turned into you" moments that every long-term couple eventually faces.

programme.title: When Engineer Falls For Doctor
programme.desc: Two worlds collide: the methodical, formula-loving engineer and the empathetic, patient doctor—catching that awkward transition from friendly banter to “oh, wait I like you” and how they adjust and match.

programme.title: 8 Funny Things That Happen In A Father-Son Relationship
programme.desc: The video is a collection of relatable "micro-moments" that define the bond between a father and son. It captures the transition from a relationship based on authority to one based on friendship, albeit with the classic "dad" quirks remaining intact.

programme.title: Every Roadtrip Ever
programme.desc: The video captures the chaotic, funny, and predictable cycle of an Indian road trip with friends. It moves through the high expectations of the planning phase to the messy (but memorable) reality of actually being on the road.

programme.title: Annoying Things People Do In Your Car
programme.desc: The video is a comedic breakdown of the various ways passengers can drive a car owner (the "driver") absolutely crazy. It captures the struggle of trying to keep your car pristine while your friends treat it like a public lounge.

programme.title: Types Of Shoppers
programme.desc: The video humorously identifies and satirizes the various personas we all adopt the moment we step into a shopping center. It breaks down the stereotypes of shopping and, in classic FilterCopy fashion, flips the script on gendered expectations—showing that men can be just as obsessive or indecisive as women when it comes to fashion.

programme.title: Thoughts You Have While Studying
programme.desc: The video is a comedic dive into the brain of a student who is desperately trying to focus but is constantly derailed by distractions, procrastination, and existential dread. It perfectly captures the "pre-exam" struggle where everything in the world seems more interesting than the textbook in front of you.

programme.title: Backbenchers Vs Toppers
programme.desc: The sketch reimagines the battle between disciplined Toppers and chaotic Backbenchers as a supernatural war. Inspired by Brahmastra, it turns exams and school life into a dramatic, high-stakes fight for ultimate power.

programme.title: Savage Millennial Vs Savage Gen Z
programme.desc: The video explores the generational divide through a series of "savage" exchanges between a Millennial (struggling to keep up) and a Gen Z protagonist (who seems to have a slang for everything). It highlights the hilarious friction that occurs when Millennial "hustle culture" meets Gen Z "boundaries."

programme.title: Life In Boy's School
programme.desc: The video is a high-energy, chaotic exploration of the "survival game" that is an all-boys school. It captures the specific brand of brotherhood, unfiltered humor, and lack of decorum that defines these institutions, moving away from typical co-ed romance to focus purely on the "bro" dynamic.

programme.title: People We See In Every Exam!
programme.desc: The video is a humorous "field guide" to the specific personalities you encounter in a high-pressure examination hall. It captures the frantic, sometimes absurd behavior of students during those three hours of "do or die" academic battle.

programme.title: What If Dhurandhar Was Set In An Office?
programme.desc: The sketch reimagines the intense, high-stakes world of international espionage as the equally "dangerous" jungle of a modern 9-to-5 office. It follows an undercover agent who is sent into a rival firm—not to stop a terror cell, but to prevent the poaching of a major client.

programme.title: Life In A Girls' School
programme.desc: The video explores the "behind-the-scenes" reality of growing up in an all-girls environment—shattering the dainty stereotypes often seen in movies and replacing them with the raw, chaotic, and fiercely loyal brotherhood (or sisterhood) that actually exists.

programme.title: Gen Z Gf Millennial Bf
programme.desc: The story follows a couple navigating the humorous friction that arises when a Millennial's "old school" habits clash with a Gen Z's digital-first lifestyle. It moves beyond simple "slang" jokes to show how their different outlooks on work, romance, and even weekend plans create both conflict and a unique kind of balance.

programme.title: Life In Iit
programme.desc: The video moves past the "glamour" of the IIT brand to show the gritty, exhausting, and heartwarming reality of hostel life. It follows three roommates as they navigate the transition from being "JEE toppers" in their hometowns to being "average students" in a campus full of geniuses.

programme.title: Parents On Facebook
programme.desc: The video is a satirical look at the digital generation gap. It follows a son (Dhruv) as he deals with the social media "awakening" of his mother (Kritika), who approaches Facebook with the same intensity and lack of boundaries she uses in real-life parenting.

programme.title: Confusing Things Girlfriends Say
programme.desc: The video is a comedic "survival guide" for boyfriends trying to navigate the often contradictory and cryptic language of their significant others. It humorously deconstructs the hidden meanings behind common phrases that leave men scratching their heads.

programme.title: Annoying Things Boyfriends Do
programme.desc: While the first video looked at the "mysterious" language of girlfriends, this sketch flips the perspective. It humorously catalogs the predictable, clumsy, and often thoughtless habits of boyfriends that test their partners' patience.

programme.title: What Not To Say In A Relationship
programme.desc: The video follows a series of scenarios where a partner says the absolute worst possible thing at a sensitive moment. It highlights how even a small, unintentionally honest comment can be interpreted as a declaration of war.

programme.title: Things Brothers & Sisters Do
programme.desc: The video is a rapid-fire montage of the daily friction and unspoken affection that defines a sibling bond. It moves past the "emotional" stereotypes to show the hilarious, grounded reality of living under the same roof.

programme.title: Last Diwali Before Moving Out
programme.desc: When you are leaving your house, every moment becomes unforgettable especially festivities like Diwali which makes core memories of growing up Desi.

programme.title: If Google Were A Delhi Boy
programme.desc: The video imagines how Google might behave if it were a stereotypical “Delhi boy” — flashy, informal, always full of attitude. It plays with contrasts like professionalism vs. casual swagger, creating funny scenarios when tech meets typical Delhi-style personality.

programme.title: When You Grow Up With Strict Desi Parents
programme.desc: The video humorously shows the challenges of growing up with strict Desi parents, from high expectations to limited freedom.

programme.title: When You Are The Only Girl In The Group
programme.desc: You’re the lone girl surrounded by guys – every conversation, joke or decision seems to orbit around you. The video captures the awkward, funny, and endearing moments you tweak just to “fit in.”

programme.title: Annoying Things Husbands Do
programme.desc: From forgetting dates to TV remote fights—an affectionate roast of husbands everywhere.

programme.title: If Google Were Poo
programme.desc: A quirky comedic sketch where imagining the search-engine giant as something ridiculous (like “Poo”) highlights how absurd our online habits and dependence on instant answers have become.

programme.desc: From foot-tapping beats to soulful melodies, Desi Beatz showcases a dynamic mix of popular artists, fresh releases, and trending music videos that reflect the pulse of today’s Punjabi youth. The show captures the essence of modern Punjab—where tradition meets contemporary sound—making it a perfect blend of rhythm, style, and desi swag. Designed for music lovers of all ages, Desi Beatz turns every moment into a celebration, whether it’s party anthems, romantic hits, or viral sensations. Tune in to GTC Punjabi Television and stay connected with what’s trending in Punjabi music—loud, lively, and full of desi energy.

programme.title: Mai Teri Tu Mera
programme.desc: Rakul's parents get her married to a boy living in Canada, but after some time he demands 25 lakh rupees from her and sends her back to India. Rakul does not see the pain of her parents and she thinks of renting out her womb.

programme.title: Surtaaj Of Punjab (o)
programme.desc: “Surtaaj of Punjab” is a vibrant Punjabi musical reality show on GTC Punjabi, celebrating the rich cultural heritage of Punjab through its aspiring singers. Hosted by Saira, Anmol Aulakh and Gurjeet Singh, the show features a diverse range of talent competing for the coveted title. Renowned music directors Gurmeet Singh and Jaidev Kumar (Music Director) along with celebrated singer Jyotika Tangri, serve as the esteemed judges, guiding contestants on a musical journey. Each episode is a celebration of talent, emotion, and the magic of Punjabi music.

programme.title: Jurm Te Jazbaat
programme.desc: This crime thriller anthology series, hosted by Ronit Roy, explores the dark side of human nature—where extreme emotions such as greed, jealousy, lust, and obsession spiral into shocking crimes. Each episode presents a standalone, fast-paced narrative inspired by passion-driven murders and intense criminal mysteries. Through gripping dramatization and Ronit Roy’s commanding narration, the series dissects the emotional triggers that push ordinary individuals toward extraordinary acts of violence. The focus goes beyond the crime itself, uncovering the psychological conflicts and fatal decisions that lead to irreversible consequences.

programme.title: Pff-Jee Ve Sohneya Jee
programme.desc: Ali, a Pakistani delivery agent in the UK, falls in love with Meher, a Sikh woman. Their emotional journey faces challenges of borders, discrimination, and the struggle to stay together.

programme.title: Let's Talk Nutrition with Mugdha Pradhan Part 02 | Difference Between Subcutaneous Fat & Visceral Fat
programme.desc: In this enlightening video, Functional Nutritionist Mugdha Pradhan breaks down the crucial differences between subcutaneous fat and visceral fat, helping you understand their distinct impacts on your health. Subcutaneous fat is the layer found directly under the skin, often noticeable in areas like the abdomen and thighs. While it’s less harmful, managing it is still important for overall fitness. On the other hand, visceral fat lies deeper, wrapping around vital organs and posing significant health risks, including heart disease and diabetes. Mugdha Pradhan offers practical advice on reducing both types of fat through balanced nutrition and lifestyle changes.

On the other hand, visceral fat lies deeper, wrapping around vital organs and posing significant health risks, including heart disease and diabetes. On the other hand, visceral fat lies deeper, wrapping around vital organs and posing significant health risks, including heart disease and diabetes. programme.desc: In this enlightening video, Functional Nutritionist Mugdha Pradhan breaks down the crucial differences between subcutaneous fat and visceral fat, helping you understand their distinct impacts on your health. Subcutaneous fat is the layer found directly under the skin, often noticeable in areas like the abdomen and thighs. While it’s less harmful, managing it is still important for overall fitness. On the other hand, visceral fat lies deeper, wrapping around vital organs and posing significant health risks, including heart disease and diabetes. Mugdha Pradhan offers practical advice on reducing both types of fat through balanced nutrition and lifestyle changes.

programme.desc: In this enlightening video, Functional Nutritionist Mugdha Pradhan breaks down the crucial differences between subcutaneous fat and visceral fat, helping you understand their distinct impacts on your health. Subcutaneous fat is the layer found directly under the skin, often noticeable in areas like the abdomen and thighs. While it’s less harmful, managing it is still important for overall fitness. On the other hand, visceral fat lies deeper, wrapping around vital organs and posing significant health risks, including heart disease and diabetes. Mugdha Pradhan offers practical advice on reducing both types of fat through balanced nutrition and lifestyle changes.

programme.desc: In this enlightening video, Functional Nutritionist Mugdha Pradhan breaks down the crucial differences between subcutaneous fat and visceral fat, helping you understand their distinct impacts on your health. Subcutaneous fat is the layer found directly under the skin, often noticeable in areas like the abdomen and thighs. While it’s less harmful, managing it is still important for overall fitness. On the other hand, visceral fat lies deeper, wrapping around vital organs and posing significant health risks, including heart disease and diabetes. On the other hand, visceral fat lies deeper, wrapping around vital organs and posing significant health risks, including heart disease and diabetes. programme.title: Let's Talk Nutrition with Mugdha Pradhan Part 02 | Difference Between Subcutaneous Fat & Visceral Fat
programme.desc: In this enlightening video, Functional Nutritionist Mugdha Pradhan breaks down the crucial differences between subcutaneous fat and visceral fat, helping you understand their distinct impacts on your health. Subcutaneous fat is the layer found directly under the skin, often noticeable in areas like the abdomen and thighs. While it’s less harmful, managing it is still important for overall fitness. On the other hand, visceral fat lies deeper, wrapping around vital organs and posing significant health risks, including heart disease and diabetes. Mugdha Pradhan offers practical advice on reducing both types of fat through balanced nutrition and lifestyle changes.

programme.title: Let's Talk Nutrition with Mugdha Pradhan Part 02 | Difference Between Subcutaneous Fat & Visceral Fat
programme.desc: In this enlightening video, Functional Nutritionist Mugdha Pradhan breaks down the crucial differences between subcutaneous fat and visceral fat, helping you understand their distinct impacts on your health. Subcutaneous fat is the layer found directly under the skin, often noticeable in areas like the abdomen and thighs. While it’s less harmful, managing it is still important for overall fitness. On the other hand, visceral fat lies deeper, wrapping around vital organs and posing significant health risks, including heart disease and diabetes. Mugdha Pradhan offers practical advice on reducing both types of fat through balanced nutrition and lifestyle changes.

programme.desc: In this enlightening video, Functional Nutritionist Mugdha Pradhan breaks down the crucial differences between subcutaneous fat and visceral fat, helping you understand their distinct impacts on your health. Subcutaneous fat is the layer found directly under the skin, often noticeable in areas like the abdomen and thighs. While it’s less harmful, managing it is still important for overall fitness. On the other hand, visceral fat lies deeper, wrapping around vital organs and posing significant health risks, including heart disease and diabetes. Mugdha Pradhan offers practical advice on reducing both types of fat through balanced nutrition and lifestyle changes.

programme.title: Ayurveda with Dimple Jangda Ep 07 - Ayurvedic remedies for improving immunity
programme.desc: join us as we explore how Ayurveda can help boost your immunity. Hosted by Dimple Jangda, a renowned expert in Ayurveda, we delve into the ancient wisdom of Ayurvedic practices and their powerful impact on enhancing your immune system.

programme.title: Celebrity Fitness Secrets-Vicky Kaushal
programme.desc: In this video, we unveil the secrets behind Bollywood heartthrob Vicky Kaushal's impressive physique. We delve into his regimented strength training routines that sculpt his lean muscle and toned core. You'll also discover his go-to cardio exercises for building endurance and a healthy heart. But it's not just exercise! We explore Vicky's clean eating plan packed with whole foods and essential nutrients, plus his tips for portion control to fuel his workouts and keep him in peak condition. Get ready to be inspired and take the first step towards achieving your own fitness goals!

programme.title: Ayurveda with Dimple Jangda Ep 08 - Ayurveda Tips and Superfood for Good Health
programme.desc:
In this video, we dive into the world of Ayurveda to bring you essential tips and powerful superfoods that can enhance your overall well-being. Ayurveda, the ancient Indian system of medicine, offers a holistic approach to health by focusing on balancing the body, mind, and spirit.
Discover simple yet effective Ayurvedic practices that you can incorporate into your daily routine to boost your energy, improve digestion, and strengthen your immune system. We’ll also introduce you to some Ayurvedic superfoods known for their incredible health benefits, helping you achieve optimal health naturally.

programme.title: Ayurveda with Dimple Jangda Ep 01 - Why Gut Health Is Important
programme.desc: In this video, we delve into the importance of gut health and what Ayurveda has to say about it. Join us with Dr. Dimple Jangda, a renowned Ayurveda coach, as she provides deep insights into gut health and explains its significance through the lens of Ayurveda. Discover how our gut health impacts our entire body and how Ayurvedic approaches differ from modern medicine. We will also share Ayurvedic tips and suggestions to improve your gut health.

programme.title: Ayurveda with Dimple Jangda Ep 05 - How to get relief from Stress and Anxiety through Ayurveda
programme.desc: Feeling stressed or anxious? Discover how Ayurveda can help you find relief naturally! In this video, Dimple Jangda, a renowned Ayurveda and gut health expert, shares her top Ayurvedic tips to combat stress and anxiety. From calming herbal remedies to simple lifestyle changes, learn how you can achieve a balanced and peaceful mind using ancient wisdom. Tune in and take the first step towards a calmer, more relaxed you!

programme.title: Important Test During Pregnancy: Why every pregnant mother should undergo this important test.
programme.desc: In this video, learn why every pregnant mother should undergo this important test during pregnancy. This test is important to ensure the health of both the mother and the baby. Learn how this test helps detect hidden health risks and ensure a healthy future for both you and your newborn. Watch till the end to understand the benefits and importance of this screening.

programme.title: Ayurveda with Dimple Jangda Ep 02 - How to choose the right diet according to your body type?
programme.desc: In this video, we explore how to choose the right diet according to your body type, based on Ayurvedic principles. Dimple Jangda, a renowned Ayurveda expert, explains the importance of selecting foods that align with your body's doshas (Vata, Pitta, Kapha). Learn which foods are beneficial for you and which ones to avoid. With simple and effective Ayurvedic tips, you can improve your health and lifestyle. Watch this video to discover how the right diet can help balance and maintain your body and mind's health.

programme.title: Learn about Daisuke Hori, who has been sleeping for only 30 minutes a day for the past 12 years!
programme.desc: Learn about Daisuke Hori, who has been sleeping for only 30 minutes a day for the past 12 years! Is sleeping so little during the day actually healthy? Find out the reason behind it and what doctors have to say about whether this approach is right for you.

programme.title: Embracing Freedom-Priya Paramita Paul's Triumph Over Adversity to Beauty Queen
programme.desc: "Embracing Freedom: Priya Paramita Paul's Rise from Heartbreak to Beauty Queen" is a powerful Independence Day special that celebrates the spirit of personal freedom and resilience. After enduring heartbreak, Priya Paramita Paul chose to rise above her challenges, transforming her life and emerging as a beauty queen. This inspiring video on OnlyMyHealth showcases how Priya's journey of self-discovery and empowerment mirrors the essence of independence—breaking free from the past and embracing a future filled with strength and self-love. Her story is a tribute to the power of inner freedom and the courage to redefine one's destiny.

programme.title: Ayurveda with Dimple Jangda Ep 09 - How to achieve Natural glow with Ayurveda
programme.desc: Want to know the secret to getting a natural glow? In this video, Ayurveda expert Dimple Jangda shares how you can make your skin naturally glowing without using any chemicals. Dimple Jangda will reveal some simple Ayurvedic tips, diet suggestions, and skincare routines that you can easily follow at home to achieve radiant skin. From foods that support libido and fertility to exercises that promote stamina and vitality, gain practical insights for maintaining a healthy and fulfilling sexual life. Join us as we explore the intersection of nutrition, fitness, and sexual health, empowering you to prioritize your overall well-being.

programme.title: Celebrity Fitness Secrets-Mouni Roy
programme.desc: Discover the diet and fitness secrets of the stunning Mouni Roy in this exclusive video! Uncover how this popular actress maintains her flawless figure and radiant health through a balanced diet and a rigorous fitness regime. Learn about her favorite meals, her go-to workout routines, and the lifestyle choices that keep her in top shape. Whether you're looking for new fitness inspiration or tips on clean eating, Mouni Roy's diet and fitness plan offers valuable insights for anyone aiming to achieve a healthier, more active lifestyle. Don't miss this chance to get a glimpse into the wellness habits of one of the most admired celebrities!

programme.title: Why do we have stomach issues with changing season? How to protect from Waterborne Diseases?
programme.desc: During changing weather, stomach-related issues become common. In this video, we explore why the stomach gets upset during seasonal transitions and how to prevent waterborne diseases. Learn about the precautions to take and the measures to maintain your health. We will discuss the connection between weather changes and stomach problems, the causes of waterborne diseases, and ways to avoid them by consuming safe and healthy water.

programme.title: Celebrity Fitness Secrets-Aditi Rao Hydari
programme.desc: Explore Aditi Rao Hydari's fitness routine in this insightful video. Discover her favorite workouts, diet tips, and how she maintains a balanced lifestyle. Join us as we uncover the secrets behind her fitness regimen, offering inspiration and practical insights for your own fitness journey

programme.title: Wellness Vardaan By Vidhi Chawla | EP 03 - 7 Golden Remedies to Control Fatty Liver
programme.desc: Discover the secrets to a healthy gut with certified dietitian Vidhi Chawla! In this video, Vidhi shares her expert advice on the seven golden rules you need to follow to maintain optimal gut health. These practical and easy-to-follow tips will help you improve digestion, boost your immune system, and enhance overall well-being. Whether you're dealing with digestive issues or simply looking to improve your gut health, this video is a must-watch.

programme.title: Wellness Vardaan By Vidhi Chawla | EP 17 - Foods to avoid and habits to steer clear of to reduce stress and anxiety.
programme.desc: Learn what foods to avoid and habits to steer clear of to reduce stress and anxiety. Discover how the right diet and a healthy lifestyle can help improve your mental well-being, and avoid the mistakes that may worsen your stress.

programme.title: Celebrity Fitness Secrets-Kriti Sanon
programme.desc: Discover the secrets behind Kriti Sanon's stunning physique and vibrant energy! In this video, we delve into the Bollywood actress's diet and fitness regime, providing an in-depth look at how she maintains her health and fitness.

programme.title: RajKummar Rao's Chin: Plastic Surgery or Fillers? Understanding Cosmetology I Dr. Prabha Singh
programme.desc:
Is Bollywood star Raj Kumar Rao's chiseled chin the result of plastic surgery or fillers? In this insightful video, renowned cosmetologist Dr. Prabha Singh delves into the world of celebrity cosmetic enhancements to answer this burning question.
Join us as Dr. Singh explains the differences between chin augmentation surgeries and non-surgical fillers, discussing the pros, cons, and what to expect from each procedure. With expert analysis and real-life examples, this video aims to educate and demystify the various cosmetic options available for achieving that perfect jawline.

programme.title: Understanding Monkeypox: Symptoms & Prevention Tips
programme.desc: Monkeypox is a rare but potentially serious viral infection that's been gaining attention due to its rapid spread. In this video, we break down everything you need to know about Monkeypox—its symptoms, how it spreads, and crucial prevention measures you can take to stay safe. Equip yourself with the knowledge to protect yourself and your loved ones.

programme.title: Wellness Vardaan By Vidhi Chawla | EP 11 - How to Give Proper Diet and Nutrition to Your Kids - Part 2
programme.desc: In this episode of our podcast, we chat with certified dietitian and health coach, Vidhi Chawla, about the best ways to feed your kids nutritious food. We cover everything from picky eaters to healthy snacks and meal planning. Get ready to learn simple, practical tips to help your kids thrive! Tune in now and share this with other parents.

programme.title: Harish Iyer: Leading By The Power of One's Story I LGBTQIA+ Community
programme.desc:
In this powerful and inspiring video, we delve into the extraordinary life of Harish Iyer, a renowned social activist and LGBTQ+ advocate. Harish's story is one of resilience, courage, and the transformative power of sharing one's truth.
Harish bravely opens up about his harrowing experience of childhood sexual assault, a trauma that profoundly impacted his early years. Through sheer determination and the support of loved ones, he found the strength to confront his past and begin the healing process.

programme.title: Wellness Vardaan By Vidhi Chawla | EP 05 - Why is Gut Health the 2nd Brain of Human Body
programme.desc: In this video, you'll learn about: The Gut-Brain Connection: Discover the complex relationship between your gut and your brain, and how they communicate through the gut-brain axis. The Enteric Nervous System: Understand the role of the enteric nervous system (ENS), a network of neurons in your gastrointestinal tract that functions independently and is sometimes called the "second brain." Microbiome and Mental Health: Find out how the trillions of microbes in your gut influence your mood, mental health, and overall well-being. Impact on Immune System: Learn about the gut's crucial role in maintaining a strong immune system and how it can affect your body's ability to fight off illnesses.

programme.title: Wellness Vardaan By Vidhi Chawla | EP 01 - The Magical 9-1 Formula of Balanced Diet and Life
programme.desc: In this insightful discussion, Vidhi Chawla shares her expertise on the essential components of a balanced diet, debunking common myths and misconceptions along the way. From understanding the importance of macronutrients like carbohydrates, proteins, and fats to exploring the role of micronutrients, vitamins, and minerals, you'll gain a comprehensive understanding of what it takes to achieve optimal nutrition.

programme.title: Kshan
programme.desc: After a dinner-time discussion about mental health turns sour, Kamlesh (55) riles his daughter, Disha, a clinical psychologist, into storming off from the gathering. This incites Kamlesh into visiting three doors to his past that make him realise that he himself suffers from a mental health disorder. 'Kshan' is a recollection of a broken man's traumatic events and his realisation that drives him to seek help from his daughter after learning to let go of his ego.

programme.title: Nathania
programme.desc: One evening a couple, Kishan and Aparna reach home to witness what they have feared the most. This compels them to take the most critical decision of their life. Will they be able to live with the practical decision they make?

programme.title: L'idiot
programme.desc: L’Idiot tells the story of Rinku, a young, eccentric man who is captivated by French culture and hopelessly infatuated with Mona, a charismatic and free-spirited girl in his language class. His romantic fantasies and attempts to impress Mona take a comedic yet dark twist when he encounters a mysterious “thief,” who manipulates Rinku into a dubious scheme to win Mona’s affection. Rinku’s innocent longing for friendship and love leads him into an awkward and ultimately dangerous pursuit.

programme.title: Mere Shohar Ki Begam
programme.desc: Javed already married but still he wants second marriage. His first wife Rukhsar opposed him, he beats her and second day he gets his second wife Afsana at home. Because of jealousy, bitterness revenge game starts between both wives.

programme.title: Ek Chhoti Si Lift Story
programme.desc: A shy office worker’s silent crush blossoms inside an elevator, where missed chances and quiet longing test his courage to finally speak.

programme.title: Killer By Chance
programme.desc: The story follows an introverted person who works in an office and has a small circle of friends. He becomes enamored with his female boss, and upon returning home, receives a message from a massage company offering to send a beautiful girl to his place. Initially refusing the offer, he eventually accepts and prepares for her arrival. After a night of partying and sleeping over, a tragic event occurs, revealing the true nature of the introverted man.

programme.title: Leaf
programme.desc: Raj and Neha, a newly married couple, move into a new house and soon begin sensing an eerie presence. Over time, they discover that the house is connected to their past lives, where they were caught in a karmic cycle of falling in love.

programme.title: Meera
programme.desc: In this heartfelt story, a mother calls out to her daughter, only to be scolded by her husband. Her daughter, Meera, is a special child who cannot speak or hear, yet her mother sends her to school with hope. Despite the chaos and negativity around her, Meera remains blissfully unaware, finding beauty and positivity in everything. Her innocence and zest for life serve as a touching reminder of the purity within, even in a world filled with harsh words.

programme.title: Mentoo
programme.desc: A director is accused by an upcoming actress of harassing her and asking her to sleep with him and he would cast her in his next film, these allegations literally destroy his career, but are all allegations always true?

programme.title: Kundli
programme.desc: Kundli - is a film about values in life, which change some decisions against the will of the characters. It's about two meetings of these characters in a different time period and shows the changes that have occurred in their lives. Though along with time things have changed but there are something’s which are unforgettable at the back of the mind. Kundli is a film about small things that have remained though the times have changed.

programme.title: Mingi
programme.desc: In Malaysia, Mingi and Elisa, a couple, face a challenging twist in their lives. Mingi, born blind and grappling with amnesia, travels to India for a brief visit. Tragically, during his absence, Elisa dies. The narrative introduces a doctor who believes the killer is a figment of Mingi's imagination, adding a psychological dimension to the story

programme.title: Love Ishtory
programme.desc: Chhavi belongs to a Brahmin family. She loves Aakash who is from a backward caste. Chhavi’s father is very disappointed with her daughter’s decision. Her father orders local inspector Dubey to catch Aakash to rough him up. But Chhavi’s elder brother Vicky appears in between. Vicky’s intention seems as he will blow Aakash’s head off. But there is a twist in the tale.

programme.title: In Your Arms
programme.desc: Payal and Nikhil have been married for 14 years, have lived happily and celebrated all the important occasions together. But now, sitting at the breakfast table, Nikhil breaks his silence, tells Payal that he does not want to drag this relation any further since there is no love left in their relationship. He confesses that he is in love with his colleague and they should get a divorce. Payal tells him that she will give him divorce but she has conditions which need to be fulfilled. Will Nikhil agree to it? What is the condition? Watch this awesome romantic short film to find out.

programme.title: Late Night Taxi
programme.desc: All the fears of a girl come to life after she travels in a late-night taxi she had booked. Does she reach home safely?

programme.title: Life 2.0
programme.desc: Life 2.0 is the reflection of modern life, where Humans have become like God. GOD means generator, operator & destroyer but look at us, what are we doing; we are also doing the same.

programme.title: Kissss
programme.desc: Joy and Ichcha elope from their respective houses as their parents are against them getting married. They take shelter at Joy's friend, Mihir's place. Mihir, who meets Ichcha for the first time is enchanted with her beauty. He is wondering why the families are against such a wonderful pair. Watch to find out the secret behind.

programme.title: Laali (bahaar Part 02)
programme.desc: Bahaar is a haunting tale of a young bride crushed under the weight of infertility and expectations. Once cherished, she’s slowly erased—until the family finds a “solution.” A heart breaking reflection on womanhood, shame, and broken promises.

programme.title: Ludo
programme.desc: Two girls accidentally find out that in addition to the man they unknowingly share, they also share a lot of gifts from him. Including a game of Ludo which resembles their lives in some manner.

programme.title: Manita
programme.desc: In a tale of wealth and solitude, two orphaned brothers lead opulent yet lonely lives, marked by the younger sibling's constant neglect by the elder.

programme.title: My Mothers Last Birthday Gift
programme.desc: Confronting terminal lung cancer, a resolute mother sets out on a heartfelt journey to prepare her bright 7-year-old son with the emotional strength to cope with her impending absence, treasuring their remaining time together.

programme.title: Nazariyaa
programme.desc: Mihika, a 22 year old, fights with her dad yet again over going out late at night. She finds it very unreasonable of him to be so worried now that she’s 22. Waiting for her cab, she overhears her building’s supervisor talking on a phone call with his own daughter. She steps in and debates with him about how he shouldn’t be upset about her being out late at night but understands his perspective too in the process. She then goes back home to apologise and reconcile with her dad. The supervisor also understands his daughter’s situation better through this chance encounter.

programme.title: Late Lateef
programme.desc: Amir, who is in his mid-20s, is struggling with self-doubt and feeling trapped in his work routine. Unfortunately, his habit of being consistently late has caused him to fall out of favor with many people, including himself. This has created a vicious cycle that he has been unable to break free from despite his best efforts. However, having a supportive inner voice has been a great blessing for him as he tries to push through his struggles.

programme.title: Kidnapped
programme.desc: Love has many things hidden instore. What happens and Why does it happen? The secrets will be revealed in Kidnapped

programme.title: Dimming Shadows
programme.desc: The husband and wife both suffer from dementia, but with the help of a compassionate doctor and nurse, they make an effort to recover. Unfortunately, their attempts are unsuccessful, but their daughter finds solace in visualizing her parents as alive through virtual reality

programme.title: Love, Bites
programme.desc: Love, bites is a romantic drama where the story revolves around the lives of Karthik, an artist, and Meghna, scientist. Their sexual chemistry is obvious to everyone. Even to those who haven’t seen them together, since they like to flaunt the hickeys on their body. But something changes in their equation when the hickey becomes a bridge of memory that leads to an old sexual encounter Meghna had which Karthik finds out about. Will Meghna be able to help Karthik erase the marks of her past? Or will Karthik just to have to wake up to a realization that the past, even though it haunts, might not be real.

programme.title: Kshan
programme.desc: After a dinner-time discussion about mental health turns sour, Kamlesh (55) riles his daughter, Disha, a clinical psychologist, into storming off from the gathering. This incites Kamlesh into visiting three doors to his past that make him realise that he himself suffers from a mental health disorder. 'Kshan' is a recollection of a broken man's traumatic events and his realisation that drives him to seek help from his daughter after learning to let go of his ego.
